selection: Exact first tested full contract restored into GeneratedOutputContract; no additional prompt edits or model calls after the selection.
routingIntegration: Generated-capable Chat and read_contract() select the complete GeneratedOutputContract once. Basic-only Chat continues using the original BasicOutputContract. The complete selected contract includes its basic vocabulary internally; it must not be prefixed a second time.
executionSemantics: New palm fields, palm-normal validation and derived automatic elbows remain. The selected contract text is not rewritten to advertise the new solver: parser omission semantics grant freedom only for unspecified directional-palm elbows, while explicit numerical/current/no-palm plans retain strict behavior.
reason: Preserve the preselected first genuine Qwen bilateral greeting with elbow-solving freedom and the original valid free-generation route. The later candidate improved some cases but introduced explicit zero elbows on this primary request, so it was not adopted.

validation.actualUnity: Parent owns current execution and final regression reports; not claimed by this CPU artifact.

limits: This is a selection between development candidates, not proof of stable autonomous planning or motion generalization.
Selected v1 still loses single-arm forward constraints, can over-retain model-inferred old palms, and can map a Japanese lateral static display to the wrong forward/dynamic goal.
Natural extended/平伸 phrases can still become explicit zero elbows, so automatic solving cannot repair every model interpretation without violating that emitted plan.
The four new expressions were evaluated once against v5 only. They must not be presented as held-out evidence for the restored v1. No second evaluation was run.
Structural validity does not show geometric feasibility, naturalness, or dialogue-purpose completeness.
